selection: Regular rounds (10/13/21) rotate one two-keyword group, one hour behind the food track so the two never share a collection window. Windows, thresholds and note types match the food track exactly; only the words and the subject differ.
coverageNotice: 基于当轮关键词与页数发现选题，未覆盖小红书全部内容。

dailySweep.selection: Once a day at 07:00 Beijing time, an hour behind the food sweep. Same shape as the food track: priority keywords first and video notes only, then the rest. Results only feed the today board.
dailySweep.prioritySource: 2026-09-15 paid probe of 13 keywords (24 requests, results in .local/fde-probe-20260915/). Ranked by median likes on the first page over all time: AI编程 984, AI Agent 732, AI落地 399, Claude Code 301; every other word fell below 100. Only AI编程 was verified to return a genuinely fresh first page under 一天内 (20 of 20 notes at most one day old); AI Agent returned 1 of 20, the rest 27 to 509 days old, so the platform's window filter silently falls back to all-time results when a keyword has too few fresh notes. Board membership is decided locally from each note's own publish time, so a stale result can never enter a board — it only costs the round some ordering.
dailySweep.source: Same probe. The literal role words (FDE 84, 前向部署工程师 37, 解决方案工程师 21 median likes) are kept in the sweep for coverage but are not priority words: the volume in this niche sits in AI engineering practice, not in the job title.
dailySweep.coverageNotice: 今日热榜来自每天 07:00 的关键词搜索，未覆盖小红书全部内容。
